Code No: E-5807/N/BL/AICTE FACULTY OF ENGINEERING B.E. I- Semester (AICTE) (Backlog) (New) Examinations, September/October 2023 Subject: Chemistry Time: 3 Hours Max. Marks: 70 Note: (i) First question is compulsory and answer any four questions from the remaining six questions. Each questions carries 14 Marks. (a) Differentiate electrolytic cells with galvanic cells. (b) What is calomel? Give the half cell reaction of calomel electrode in a typical cell. (c) Explain how sterilization of water is done using chlorine. (d) Define ppm. How many mg of CaClz dissolved per liter gives 300 ppm of hardness? (f (9 e) Write the functionality, structure of monomer and polymer for addition polymers. ) What is knocking? Explain octane and cetane numbers. ) What are composites? Write any two characteristics of composites. 2. (a) (i) Derive Nernst equation. (ii) What are fuel cells? Give their applications. b) (i) What is a secondary battery? Give examples. (ii) Explain the principle and working of lead acid battery. 3. (a) (i) Give the expressions for temporary and permanent hardness of water. (ii) Explain how the hardness of water is estimated by EDTA. (b) (i) Explain water softening by ion exchange method. (ii) What are the different corrosion control methods? Explain any one.
